3694.title: Pagination drops an anchorless group across an ownership boundary
3694.rootCauseOneLine: Ownership filtering discards a whole fallback-anchored group, then returns older-history true with a null cursor.
3694.proposedFix: Verify group ownership and a complete older-page walk with an event-backed regression before changing selection.
3694.caveats: Pure paginator reproduced twice; production event selection and performance unverified. Broken pnpm launcher blocks required fix verification.
